mainEntity.name: Should I convert my garage or build an entirely new addition for extra living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing garage into a living room is often faster and less expensive because the roof, exterior walls, and slab are already in place. However, you sacrifice covered parking and garage storage, and you must insulate the space, raise the floor, and adjust the exterior facade. Building a new ground-up living room addition preserves vehicle storage and allows you to tailor room dimensions and ceiling heights from scratch, though it requires a larger upfront investment and yard space. Evaluating your vehicle parking needs and budget helps determine the right path.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion saves on structural framing costs but eliminates enclosed parking, whereas a new ground-up addition preserves vehicle storage at a higher construction cost.
